dco: Merge DCO and UNDCO as DCO.
responsibility: Distinct entity/office pairs count as separate responsible units. DMSPC/BTAD and DMSPC/OPPFB are Joint. A recommendation counts once in global totals.
historical_entities: Retain separately and flag for review; do not map to successors.
unspecified_offices: Do not assign a department to an office unless the source names that office.
collective_names: Plural peacekeeping missions or regional commissions establish Joint responsibility, but no specific members are inferred. Entity mapping remains review-required.
rcs: Keep RCS separate from DCO (explicit user instruction, 2026-09-22).
unmsil: Normalize UNMSIL to UNSMIL based on official UN web evidence; preserve raw wording. See data/reference/eosg-provenance.json.
